title: Generic formulas for the proper open mate and its coefficient square
statement: Given categories U,V,W,Z, adjunctions lp:Z→V ⊣ rp and lr:W→U ⊣ rr, functors i:W→Z and k:U→V and a transformation ta:i⋙lp→lr⋙k, define properOpenMate:rr⋙i→k⋙rp to be the unit of lp⊣rp, followed by ta whiskered with rr and rp, followed by the counit of lr⊣rr whiskered with k and rp. This is the explicit construction of [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], with the functor-composition identifications implicit. For two such A and B diagrams and scalar functors su,sv,sw,sz, pullback/scalar transformations cp:sz⋙lpB→lpA⋙sv and cr:sw⋙lrB→lrA⋙su, and open transformations di:iA⋙sz→sw⋙iB and dk:kA⋙sv→su⋙kB, define properOpenLeft as properOpenMate_A whiskered with sz, followed by the cp mate whiskered with kA, followed by dk whiskered with rpB. Define properOpenRight as di whiskered with rrA, followed by the cr mate whiskered with iB, followed by properOpenMate_B whiskered with su. These are explicit composites, with no asserted equality as part of these definitions.

def properOpenMate
    {U V W Z : Type*} [Category U] [Category V] [Category W] [Category Z]
    {lp : Z ⥤ V} {rp : V ⥤ Z} {lr : W ⥤ U} {rr : U ⥤ W}
    (ap : lp ⊣ rp) (ar : lr ⊣ rr) (i : W ⥤ Z) (k : U ⥤ V)
    (ta : i ⋙ lp ⟶ lr ⋙ k) : rr ⋙ i ⟶ k ⋙ rp
lean.note: A real unit-map-counit construction, with no proof obligation or arbitrary chosen data. Definitionally the previous gamma formula after specialization. The scalar-square constructors retain the former left/right formulas at generic categories before specialization.
